mainEntity.name: How long does a log and cabin finish upgrade usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Timing depends on prep, weather, and how much of the finish needs to be removed. A straightforward upgrade can move quickly, while a project with stripping, repairs, or drying time takes longer. In Colorado, outdoor work also has to account for temperature swings, wind, and moisture so coatings can cure properly.
acceptedAnswer.description: Simple upgrades can be relatively quick, but full restorations take longer because of prep, repairs, and curing time. Weather and moisture can also affect the schedule.
